author: Stahly
description:
Palm trees, tree stumps, Aztec temple ruins, and rocks that finally look like they belong next to your minis: Squidmar Miniatures is moving into basing. Together with Archon Studio and Gamers Grass, Emil and Lukas have put together two themed hard plastic base decoration sets: Desert Oasis and Jungle, plus matching Plants’n’Tufts boxes to finish the job. In this post, I unbox everything, show you what’s on the sprues, and share an example base for my Aeldari Vyper, so you can decide whether your next army might become Squidmar-based.

The post Desert Oasis, Jungle, and Plants’n’Tufts: the Squidmar basing range review appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Desert Oasis, Jungle, and Plants’n’Tufts: the Squidmar basing range review
